description: Clone a sequence into a named '[checkpoint]' copy before a risky edit and return a diff_sequence_snapshots-compatible snapshot of the original. Verifies the clone exists with matching track and clip counts, re-activates the original, and never deletes or overwrites anything.

include_snapshot.description: Return the original sequence's structural snapshot for later diff_sequence_snapshots calls (default true).

sequence_id.description: Sequence ID or name to checkpoint. Defaults to the active sequence.

name: create_sequence_checkpoint

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Create Sequence Checkpoint
